propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared rebar logger at process start, preventing pytest caplog from capturing rebar.* log records in any test that runs after this call

caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail silently with StopIteration or pass vacuously (assert not) after configure_logging() has executed, making test order-dependent failures non-deterministic and invisible
propagate=False was intended to prevent double-logging through uvicorn root handlers but breaks caplog capture for all subsequent tests in the same process

The fix must restore caplog functionality while maintaining the original double-logging prevention, either by removing the propagate mutation or by conditionally applying it only in runtime (non-test) environments
